text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then, try taking the corner just 
like I taught you."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Don't forget: you only put all your 
strength in at the very end.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"That running... she seems to have broken 
out of her shell. Splendid guidance as 
always, President."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My instruction, you say...? Heh. Alright, 
feel free to praise me to your heart's 
content.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, my apologies. Truth be told, that 
advice just now was just me parroting what 
Trainer-kun said."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of passing those 
compliments straight along to him.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of passing those 
compliments straight along to her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It really is a nice feeling to 
hear one's Trainer being praised.
